'''Mesbahuddin Ahmad''' is a Bangladeshi academic. He has been a fellow of [[Bangladesh Academy of Sciences]] since 1997 and was the president of the academy during 2012–2015.<ref name="bas" /> He was the [[vice-chancellor]] of [[Gono University]] from 2008 to 2016.<ref name="bas">{{cite web |title=Fellow Details - Dr. Mesbahuddin Ahmad |url=https://www.bas.org.bd/fellow-details/56 |website=Bangladesh Academy of Sciences}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.gonouniversity.edu.bd/vice.php |title=Vice Chancellor's Message |publisher=Gono University |access-date=4 August 2016 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160827081714/http://www.gonouniversity.edu.bd/vice.php |archive-date=27 August 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/news/seminar-on-medical-physics-at-gono-university |title=Seminar on Medical Physics at Gono University |work=The Daily Star |date=8 December 2013 |access-date=4 August 2016}}</ref>

==Education and career==
Ahmad completed his master's in chemistry from the [[University of Dhaka]] in 1958. He obtained his Ph.D. from [[University of Ottawa]] in organic chemistry in 1963.<ref name="bas" />

He joined the University of Dhaka as a lecturer in 1959. He was an associate professor of the [[University of Chittagong]] from 1969 to 1972, when he became a faculty member of [[Jahangirnagar University]].<ref name="bas" />
